description: Scrape public/shareable Amazon wishlists, gift lists, baby registries, and wedding registries from URLs or bare wishlist IDs.

listIds.description: Bare wishlist IDs copied from a list URL (for example `2PBHI0DGWAAAF` from `/hz/wishlist/ls/2PBHI0DGWAAAF`). Each ID is opened on the marketplace selected below. Use this instead of `listUrls` when you only have the ID.
listIds.title: Wishlist IDs

listUrls.description: Direct, public/shareable Amazon list URLs. Accepted shapes: `/hz/wishlist/ls/<ID>`, the mobile `/gp/aw/ls?lid=<ID>`, `/gp/registry/wishlist/<ID>`, `/baby-reg/<name>/<ID>`, `/wedding/guest-view/<ID>` (or `/wedding/<name>/registry/<ID>`), and `/registries/gl/guest-view/<ID>`. This actor never searches for or enumerates lists; it only visits the exact URLs you provide.
listUrls.title: Wishlist / registry URLs

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace used to build URLs from `listIds`. Ignored for `listUrls` because each URL already carries its own marketplace.
marketplace.title: Marketplace for list IDs

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of list items scraped per list URL. The full list is followed through Amazon's own pagination until this cap is reached or the list ends.
maxItems.title: Max items per list

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy used to fetch list pages. Defaults to the free AUTO (datacenter) group; the actor escalates to a residential session automatically only if a block is detected.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

sortBy.description: Sort order for wishlist items, matching the sort control shown on the live wishlist page. Registry pages expose their own fixed sort set; unsupported values fall back to the list's default order.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Amazon Wishlist & Registry Scraper Input
